description: This file implements socket and file handle management functions for Windows, emulating POSIX socket behavior. It includes socket creation, connection, data transmission, and file operations, with internal handle management and error translation.

classes.name: FileOrSocket
classes.description: Union-like structure to represent either a file descriptor or a socket handle.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Wrapper for Windows CRITICAL_SECTION for thread synchronization.

methods.name: gen_fd
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random file descriptor number.

methods.name: handle_db_put
methods.description: Stores a handle (file or socket) in internal map and returns its assigned fd.

methods.name: handle_db_get
methods.description: Retrieves a handle from internal map by fd, optionally erasing it.

methods.name: set_errno
methods.description: Sets the thread's errno based on the last Windows socket error, translating to POSIX error codes.
